sections.title: Pioneers of *the family protection dog*
body: Harrison Prather started in 1975, training dogs for law enforcement and the U.S. government under the name LRRP K-9 Security Services. In 1995 he renamed the company: “I’m Harrison, so we should be Harrison K-9.” At the same time, the focus moved from police and military dogs to executive and family protection.

Every dog is a European German Shepherd, evaluated and trained to exact specifications in Aiken before it can be called a Harrison K-9. A well-chosen, well-trained protection dog is not a vicious attack animal: it is first an obedient, devoted companion.

items.q: Is a protection dog safe with children?
items.a: Yes. A Harrison K-9 is a family companion 99.9% of the time, obedient to every member of the family, with the training to step in only when it’s needed.
Only European German Shepherds, from bloodlines bred for temperament, working ability, health and soundness.
Yes. Training is completed to each family’s wishes, and dogs can also be trained for tracking, child search and in-home search for intruders. A list of past clients’ requests is available.
At our 25-acre compound in rural South Carolina, and out in everyday places: city streets, parks, vehicles and boats.
